SCAN TO PLAY ON YOUR PHONE

STEER — drag, mouse, or ◀ ▶ / A·D
FIRE — hold Z, mouse, or the FIRE button
MISSILE — X or right-click when you see LOCK ON
SPEED — W·S throttle · hold SHIFT for AFTERBURNER
BARREL ROLL — tap C to shake a bandit off your tail
LAND — the carrier every 3rd stage refills your missiles. Come in slow!

THE MISSION — Sega's 1987 arcade classic, rebuilt. Fight through all 22 stages: dogfights, canyon runs and fortress assaults.

SCORE — blast jets and ground targets. A missile kill on a locked target pays the most.

WATCH YOUR SIX — when the warning flashes, a bandit is on your tail. Barrel-roll to shake him off.

CARRIER LANDINGS — every 3rd stage, line up on the deck and come in slow to refill your missiles.
